constraints.source_text: All performance majors are required, as indicated in the specific curriculum listings below, to either present a senior recital or complete a culminative project. Both must be completed under approved faculty supervision and guidance.
constraints.description: Performance majors must complete a senior recital or culminative project under faculty supervision.
constraints.note: Applies to performance majors generally; treated as procedural milestone since it's not a course-list item.

constraints.source_text: A performance audition according to the requirements of the department of the applicant’s primary instrument or voice is also required.
constraints.description: Applicants must complete a performance audition as part of admission.

constraints.source_text: Music majors may accumulate a maximum of 16 units of individual instruction at the 300 level toward an undergraduate degree program.
constraints.description: No more than 16 units of 300-level individual instruction may count toward the degree.
Students must complete 6 general education courses.

constraints.source_text: MPxx 153 Units: 4 units total of individual instruction in primary instrument/voice / MPxx 253 Units: 4 units total of individual instruction in primary instrument/voice / MPxx 353 Units: 4 units total individual instruction in primary instrument/voice / MPKS 250a Keyboard Instruction I Units: 2 / MPKS 250b Keyboard Instruction I Units: 2 / Ensemble electives Units: 2 units total / MUCO 132a Aural Skills I Units: 2 / MUCO 132b Aural Skills I Units: 2 / MUCO 133a Theory I Units: 3 / MUCO 133b Theory I Units: 3 / MUCO 232a Aural Skills II Units: 2 / MUCO 232b Aural Skills II Units: 2 / MUCO 233a Theory II Units: 3 / MUCO 233b Theory II Units: 3 / MUHL 231 Music History Units: 3 / MUHL 232 Music History II Units: 3 / MUHL 331 Music History III Units: 3 / MUHL 332 Studies in Musical Culture Units: 3 / MUIN 270 Introduction to the Music Industry Units: 4 / MUIN 280 Communications in the Music Industry Units: 4 / MUIN 360 Introduction to Music Law Units: 4 / MUIN 450 Practicum in Music Industry Issues (Internship) Units: 1, 2, 3, 4 (8 units total)

constraints.note: Grouped multiple fixed-course listings into one record; ensemble electives 'units total' noted but no pool given.

constraints.source_text: MUCD 340 Choral Conducting I Units: 2 or MUCD 343 Instrumental Conducting I Units: 2

Students must complete 6 units of electives with no defined course list given.
Students must complete a Junior Recital milestone (0 units) under faculty supervision.
constraints.note: No explicit description of the recital's requirements beyond its listing; treated as a procedural milestone.

constraints.source_text: All individual instruction units must be taken in the same area in which the students auditioned.
constraints.description: Individual instruction units must match the student's audition area.

unclassified.source_text: It requires eight courses in six Core Literacies, plus two courses in Global Perspectives (which may double-count with courses in the Core Literacies) and two courses in writing.
unclassified.why: Describes the university-wide general education program structure rather than a specific requirement of this program; overlaps with GE requirement already recorded but adds a double-counting note not clearly attributable to this program's own requirement text.

unclassified.source_text: The provost has allowed an exception to the rules governing the new general education requirements for certain groups of students pursuing performance degrees in music. Students pursuing the Bachelor of Music in Jazz Studies or the Bachelor of Music in Performance (in all tracks except organ) may satisfy their social issues and first writing requirement separately by taking WRIT 130 (instead of WRIT 150) in the spring of their freshman year. In addition those pursuing the Bachelor of Music in Performance (vocal arts) may satisfy Category I of the new program with MUHL 331 and MUHL 332.
unclassified.why: This exception applies to other majors (Jazz Studies, Performance), not to Music Industry (BM), so it is not a requirement for this program.

unclassified.source_text: In all other respects, students in the Thornton School of Music must satisfy the general education requirements as described on the General Education Program page.
unclassified.why: References external page for GE requirements rather than stating a specific constraint; too vague to encode.
States total degree units but is not a distribution, selection, reuse, or sequencing constraint on specific courses; it's an aggregate total not matching any taxonomy family.
